services.name: Diamondback Gulch
services.desc: Tour Length: 2 hours About Buckle up and hold on for the ride of your life on Sedona's most extreme 4-wheel drive trail. This adrenaline-packed 4 x 4 experience is not for the faint of heart so be prepared. Embark on a desert adventure along one of Arizona's most rugged trails while discovering some of the most famous rock formations such as Capitol Butte, Chimney Rock, Lizard Head and Doe Mesa. Snake along the Sidewinder Trail into the depths of Diamondback Gulch. Your heart will pound as one of your jeep guide navigates this stunning grand arroyo and climbs to the other 2 hours • Extreme • Sells out Daily!

services.name: Lil' Rattler
services.desc: Length: 2 hours About This trail may be a lil’ less extreme then the Diamondback, but it will still rattle you up! Head on out and view picturesque landscapes and open vistas as you make your way over big boulders and rocky roads—it’s sure to please all ages. The Sedona Western canyons are the perfect spot to enjoy an off-road adventure of a lifetime. On the Lil'Rattler Jeep Tour, we don't shake your brain as much as on our Diamondback Gulch Tour, but we'll make sure you get a taste of the action as you ride along Red Rock Range. Your guide will take you through picturesque 2 Hours • Great for Families!

blurb: Guests take private Jeep tours through Sedona's red rock country, exploring scenic trails, historic sites, and panoramic vistas. Tours vary from easy rides to extreme 4x4 experiences, with opportunities to hike, take photos, and learn local history. The company operates year-round with a focus on safety and environmental stewardship.
